question: Among other properties with respect to hypericin we can indicate:

options.opa: It is a powerful hepatoprotector extracted from the roots of Hypericum perforatum.
options.opb: It is a powerful cholagogue that is extracted from the resin of the Hypericum perforatum rhizome.
options.opc: It is a removable antiretroviral of the aerial parts of Hypericum perforatum.
options.opd: It is a laxative that is extracted from the leaves of Hypericum perforatum.
options.ope: It is a potent hepatoprotective present in the fruits of Hypericum perforatum.
